Sunset Banquets — Wedding Banquet Hall, Delhi-NCR

Sunset Banquets is a mid-size banquet venue in Delhi-NCR with an air-conditioned
indoor hall (capacity ~500) and a connected lawn (capacity ~700). It is a
practical, well-located choice for city weddings without a destination budget.

The hall-plus-lawn package is ₹3,80,000 per day, including basic lighting and
parking. Catering is in-house, with outside decorators permitted.

Contact: +91 98184 21570 · book@sunsetbanquets.example
Location: Rohini, Delhi
Rating: 4.4 / 5 (171 reviews)
